registryBoundary: Located Story3.15 registry is historical packet evidence, not a newly authenticated current roster/role grant. Its bmad:murat entry is a tool persona, not a second human.

requirements.candidate: One approved, content-bound final source/evidence/dependency/validator subject; any changed bound input invalidates affected evidence.
requirements.exactSourceCI: Fresh affected Release/package and Live suite outcomes, exact source SHA, workflow digest, dependency/runtime identity and sanitized native evidence; no unexpected skips/warnings/errors.
requirements.seal: Retrieve validator result from CI platform under authenticated platform identity, for the required dedicated workflow run consuming this guarded Story6.4/NFR8 transition, bound to exact head SHA and workflow-file digest. Ordinary local runs or non-required live evaluation never seal.
requirements.fixtureJobs: Required validator fixture jobs observe negative fixtures failing beside positive control. Non-required per-main-push live evaluation publishes content-bound truthful PASS/FAIL and is evidence only.
requirements.roster: Authenticated effective owner-role registry determines required level; one human means single-maintainer-attested; two or more means independent, including an authenticated human approver distinct from author. Tool/CI identities never count as humans.
requirements.attestation: Authenticated owner approval bound to exact runtime acceptance subject and role registry, issued at least24hours after last authored change to that subject; no timestamp or approval fabricated from specification approval or current authorization.
requirements.labels: Consuming sealed transition computes achieved assurance; reject overstated or below-required levels; downstream records carry lowest achieved level of their inputs.
requirements.transition: Seal attaches to this guarded transition and blocks its effect, never main; do not mark Story6.4 done while gates fail.
requirements.predecessors: Rerun any consumed predecessor validator inside sealed transition with its bound identity/pinned commit; reject mismatch.
requirements.authorityBoundary: Existing October15 three-role approval authorizes normative implementation only; no runtime NFR8 acceptance, CI seal, production qualification or cutover authority.
